title: chore: allow AkshayCoder48 community publishing
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Adds `AkshayCoder48` (GitHub ID `198414737`) to the community-model publisher allowlist.
- Changes only the immutable GitHub ID allowlist.

Checks:
- `biome check shared/auth/github-id-list.ts`
- `git diff --check`

Addresses #12578

gist.headline: A new gardener gets keys
gist.blurb: AkshayCoder48 can now publish community models to the hive. One more set of hands for the shared garden.
gist.summary: Added GitHub ID 198414737 (AkshayCoder48) to the immutable community-model publisher allowlist.
gist.impact: AkshayCoder48 can now publish community models, expanding the set of contributor-built options available through Pollinations.
gist.visual_concept: Depict Polli warmly welcoming a new community gardener at a small code-garden gate marked as an approved publisher, with a retro terminal showing a GitHub-style ID badge and model seedlings ready to be planted.
gist.image_prompt: Cozy pixel art scene of Polli, the cute yellow-and-brown striped bee mascot with pink cheek blush, light blue wings, and a tiny gardener hat, handing a glowing lime green (#ecf874) garden key to a friendly new coder beside a retro terminal showing a simple GitHub ID badge. Community model seedlings sprout from flower pots around an open garden gate, with soft mint, lavender, peach, and warm cream gradients; cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes, emotionally warm.
